adversarial_claim: A detected policy violation places a security hold, or a gateway's report that it saw no violation earns the agent positive policy_adherence weight.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Detected policy violation': SECURITY reported by gateway, FAILURE, policy_adherence; causal_assessment AGENT, so one attributable failure (14.6 rules 8, 9, 12). It cites the gateway's violation record of its task and operation (14.2). It places no hold (15.4): security_status stays CLEAR.

Draft 14.5 and 14.6 rule 12: a gateway SECURITY report other than a FAILURE on policy_adherence is UNQUALIFIED. 'No violation observed' is an admission pass in disguise and earns no positive reputation (14.3).
